name: The Finders (Demo)
summary:
"The Finders" is a VR game that challenges players to find objects throughout Pet-World. It’s a mini open-world game where players can explore maps, complete exciting quests, play various mini-games, hang out with other players (Full version), collect objects, and level up to become the best "Finder."

Features:
- Cute animals
- Sandbox exploration
- Main Quest 
- Mini games

More features will be added in the full version, which will be released in February 2025!
